issue: r4a-generic-values (#76ba): shared bounded storage used in two domains

library.api: Bounded :: struct($T, $N) { slots: [$N] $T; count: int; } with bounded_push, bounded_pop, bounded_get, bounded_set, bounded_clear, bounded_view, bounded_full over a one-element view of caller-owned storage
library.refusal: push on a full store, pop on an empty one, set outside the live slots and any of the three with a count outside 0..N return false and change nothing; get and view trap on an index or count outside the live slots
